adoption.notes: From fc72969e the runtime serves the six approver registry operations on its operator socket, under the request bound and framing this version gives every request, and runs this version's approver registry corpus, vendored at 3596a5e, through OperatorSocketServer.answer against a real state store; all 600 cases pass. Its release notes and module docstrings name this version as the draft the socket carries, and its capability matrix records the operator socket, approver registry included as Partial, so the version is not frozen by this merge: under VERSIONING's Freeze Rule an explicitly partial implementation does not freeze, and naming the contract a component serves is provenance. Its deployed admission is partial because the installer does not write the operator identity. It has no release, and its evidence is host tests and CI.

notes: The successor of operator-socket/v2. It adds the approver registry's local operations that tier-c-approvers/v1 delivers through this socket, with a request bound and framing that apply to every request on the socket; the rest is v2's. The runtime serves the registry operations on its main branch, and no release carries them; the runtime is the enforcing repository.
